paragraphs: Rabbi Levi bar Chayta: end of Moed Katan. In the book Ahavat Tziyon VeYerushalayim on Sheviit 4:6 the author conjectures that where it says there “Rabbi Chiyya bar Ba said, Chayta,” this is Chayta, the father of Rabbi Levi.
